purpose: Machine-readable execution and ownership map for every public cultivation tool. Resolve this registry before editing, moving, building, mirroring or deploying a tool.
rules: Every public tool route has exactly one canonical repository.
dtfgenetics/Thc is the production integration/deployment authority, not automatically the authoring source.
dtfgenetics/Tools owns the focused cultivation/reference suite but does not own GrowLens or Grow Doc.
Grow Doc is authored in dtfgenetics/Thc-dataset and integrated into Thc as a pinned deployment artifact.
Dtf420 and dtf-thc-hub are migration workspaces and may not become canonical tool owners without an explicit registry change.
Generated or synchronized mirrors must never be edited as the upstream source.

tools.name: THC GrowLens
tools.edit_rule: Edit GrowLens application/runtime in dtfgenetics/Thc only. Do not implement GrowLens in Tools, Dtf420, or legacy hub repositories.

tools.name: THC Grow Doc
tools.edit_rule: Edit diagnostics, diagnostic UI, taxonomy, evidence and model-control code in dtfgenetics/Thc-dataset. Thc may only pin/package/deploy the verified artifact.

tools.name: Tools Hub
tools.edit_rule: Author implementation, UI, math and tool-specific data in dtfgenetics/Tools. The Thc copy is a deployable mirror and must not become an alternate authoring source.
